arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM main.Patient AS p
JOIN main.Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.WBC > 3.5
  AND l.WBC < 9.0
  AND (l.FG <= 150 OR l.FG >= 450)
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 15
LIMIT 1
